key_insight: LLM-generated quantum circuits need layered validation because failures can be structural, plausible, and even introduced by the evaluation harness itself.
engineering_relevance: For quantum software pipelines, gatekeeper screening and fidelity checks are essential to prevent erroneous circuit generation from contaminating expensive VQE workflows.
method: Seven-criterion gatekeeper rubric for physical and framework validity
Circuit fidelity comparison against analytical and reference H2/STO-3G/Jordan-Wigner/UCCSD values
Design entropy to measure run-to-run consistency
evidence_signal: The framework was applied across multiple foundation models in a Materials Project-integrated pipeline, revealing five distinct failure modes and two harness-induced failures from silent fallback-template substitution.
watch_item: Evaluation infrastructure must be audited as part of the trusted system, since harness bugs can masquerade as model errors and distort conclusions.
paper_title: Gatekeepers and Hallucinations: A Layered Evaluation Framework for LLM-Driven Quantum Circuit Generation
